invite.usage: Use invite export with all required explicit flags.
invite.account: Supply a valid explicit invitation account within the path budget.
invite.output-path: Choose a new archive in an existing nonsymlink directory.
invite.output-exists: Choose a new archive pathname; existing output is never replaced.
invite.plan-read: Supply a bounded local nonsymlink regular plan file.
invite.preparation-read: Supply a bounded local nonsymlink regular preparation file.
invite.plan-decode: Correct the plan file's format before export.
invite.preparation-decode: Correct the preparation file's format before export.
invite.plan-identity: Give the organization plan a nonempty identity before export.
invite.plan-invalid: Inspect the plan with the supported stdio validate workflow and correct its validation errors before export.
invite.preparation-invalid: Correct the preparation identity or details before export.
invite.onboarder-blocked: Supply or deliberately defer the required onboarder answers before export.
invite.owner: Name the onboarding owner in preparation with a usable display name.
invite.preaccess-help: Designate a known named business contact with a displayable pre-access help route.
invite.firststeps: Correct the help selection or first-steps inputs before export.
invite.plan-encode: Correct plan values that cannot be encoded before export.
invite.preparation-encode: Correct preparation values that cannot be encoded before export.
invite.record-encode: The identity-only record seed could not be encoded.
invite.archive: Keep all invitation payloads within the archive limits.
invite.publish: The new archive could not be safely published; existing files were preserved.
invite.cleanup-refused: No archive was published, but temporary invitation data may remain. Restore access to the selected output directory and check exporter-owned temporary data before retrying.
invite.cleanup-written: The archive was written, but temporary invitation data may remain. Keep the archive; restore access to the selected output directory and check exporter-owned temporary data.
invite.written: Pre-access help availability has not been tested; deliver through an approved channel.
invite.result-output: The archive was written, but its result could not be fully displayed.
invite.help-output: The usage text could not be displayed.
